hints.title: Tabular Structure Construction
hints.text: Raw nested collections lack named axes and schema definitions. How can a two-dimensional collection of values be converted directly into an indexed tabular structure with explicit column titles?

hints.title: DataFrame Constructor Projection
hints.text: The standard DataFrame constructor accepts nested lists alongside an explicit list of column names, establishing the two-dimensional tabular representation immediately.

hints.title: Constructor Invocation with Column Names
hints.text: Call pd.DataFrame passing student_data as the first argument and columns=['student_id', 'age'] as the second argument. Return the resulting DataFrame object.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of rows in student_data
complexity.notes: Linear tabular instantiation in contiguous columnar memory.
